title: Structural and Functional Left Ventricular Remodelling in Patients With Obstructive Sleep Apnea
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether patients with obstructive sleep apnea have any changes in left ventricular function and structure after 06 months of continuous positive airway pressure treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Apnea-hypopnea index higher than 5 events per hour

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index higher than 40 kg/m2
